Create the full "Decorations and Medals" business process strictly according to the provided BPMN diagram.
1) Head of O.U. — Submit application for distinction
- Stores employee data, organizational unit, decoration type, justification
2) Personnel Department (PD) — Present applications for acceptance to PRK / Chancellor
3) PRK / Chancellor — Review applications and forward to PD
- Forwards reviewed application back to PD
4) Personnel Department (PD) — Present reviewed applications to Rector
- PD forwards the reviewed application to Rector (RKR)
- Process ends immediately with status = Rejected
7) Military Personnel Department (MPD) — Handle applications (external transfer)
- MPD processes the accepted decoration externally
- Forwards result back to Personnel Department (PD)
8) Personnel Department (PD) — Receive decision on award
- PD receives the decision from MPD
9) Personnel Department (PD) — Enter decoration into register
- Each step MUST have its own task UI
- Tasks MUST appear in the existing Tasks list
- Show a Process Timeline component reflecting exactly the BPMN steps
- Completed steps should be visually marked
